targets.rawSql: SELECT minute AS time, severity, sum(event_count) AS value FROM syslog_ml.events_by_minute WHERE minute BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY minute, severity ORDER BY minute
SELECT minute AS time, predicted_category, sum(event_count) AS value FROM syslog_ml.events_by_minute WHERE minute BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY minute, predicted_category ORDER BY minute
SELECT sum(anomaly_count) AS anomalies FROM syslog_ml.events_by_minute WHERE minute >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE

SELECT host, predicted_category, count() AS events FROM syslog_ml.events WHERE event_time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND severity IN ('err','crit','alert','emerg') GROUP BY host, predicted_category ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 25
